definitions.gloss: thinning hair; thin hair; hair loss
definitions.explanation: A condition where hair becomes noticeably thinner or sparser, typically on the head. A more neutral and less blunt term than はげ (bald).

examples.japanese: {薄毛|うすげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm worried about my thinning hair.

examples.japanese: {薄毛|うすげ}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started using a shampoo for thinning hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧{薄毛|うすげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進行|しんこう}して→進行する：26794_shinkousuru⟧、⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As I aged, my thinning hair progressed and I started wearing hats more often.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ (thin) and {毛|げ} (hair). A softer, more tactful way to describe hair loss than はげ (bald) or ⟦{禿|は}げる→禿げる：20344_hageru⟧ (to go bald). Very common in advertising for hair care products.

USAGE:
{薄毛|うすげ} is the preferred term in polite conversation, advertising, and medical contexts. It describes the condition without the bluntness of はげ. Extremely common in TV commercials, product labels, and men's health discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄毛|うすげ}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ — measures against thinning hair
- {薄毛|うすげ}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ — hair thinning treatment
- {薄毛|うすげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進行|しんこう}する→進行する：26794_shinkousuru⟧ — thinning hair progresses
- {薄毛|うすげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧ — to be troubled by thinning hair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- はげ — bald, baldness (more direct, can be rude)
- ⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧ — hair loss (clinical term; also means hair removal)
- ⟦{抜|ぬ}け{毛|げ}→抜け毛：25668_nukege⟧ — hair that has fallen out; shedding
